title: Obsidian New-Note Creation Drought
app: Obsidian Sync, Todoist, Toggl Track, Google Calendar / iCloud calendar exports, and task metadata ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obsidian:note event=create
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as new_notes by vault _time
| where new_notes<3
| sort new_notes
description: Uses Obsidian note-creation events telemetry to monitor weekly pace of new notes in each vault in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for periods when capture has gone unusually quiet, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Obsidian note-creation events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates weekly pace of new notes in each vault so you can spot periods when capture has gone unusually quiet before it becomes annoying.
